mission: Deliver exact-height virtualization for the editor-stack thread renderer by consuming the @beep/pretext root surface plus a capture pass in the client.
statusNote: Editor-stack ownership was confirmed clear by the operator on 2026-08-13. The 2026-07-14 beep-effect6 gate release covered only the desktop shell; this confirmation covers the thread renderer surface.

provenance.note: Goal 2 from the exploration MAP. The 2026-07-14 review routed kernel residue to scratchpad/dockview/WHAT-IS-LEFT.md; on 2026-07-16 that retired scratchpad file was migrated into goals/dock-substrate-landing/README.md Residuals.

completionGate.statement: Not achieved until this goal's work ships as a PR driven to mergeable via Yeet: `bun run beep yeet repair`, `bun run beep yeet verify`, `bun run beep yeet publish --pr --message "..."`, `bun run beep yeet monitor`.

stopConditions: The live thread-renderer ownership boundary changes or conflicts with another lane.
The @beep/pretext root surface cannot provide the required exact-height contract.
The implementation would absorb dock-kernel residue or unrelated editor work.
Verification requires unnamed credentials, cost, destructive side effects, or policy approval.
